findings.evidence: Constitution gate for X asks for stage-discipline, repair-budget, and convergence-severity tests; FR-003a says the skills have no tests. The constitution wins until amended, and no exception is logged. T109.

Constitution VIII: documented upgrade path and rollback procedure MUST be preserved; gate requires rollback docs. Grep finds neither in README, CONTRIBUTING, CLAUDE, SECURITY, quickstart, or docs/18. T110.

Constitution I gate says a license scan proves MIT; CI has no scan and plan.md substitutes LICENSE present, with no logged exception. Constitution line 167 makes an unapproved exception a compliance violation. T111.

Constitution VIII gate asks for a risk-proportionate test matrix in the PR, and line 226 requires every PR to verify compliance; pull_request_template.md has no matrix, principle compliance, or exception item. T112.

Constitution IX gate requires required reviews enforced; branch protection has required_approving_review_count 0 (checked 2026-11-06). docs/18 and PR 3's notes report the gap, but no exception states scope, expiry, and approval as lines 229-231 require. T113.

SKILL section 4 writes the record and inventory status on entering a stage, then specify blocks on a dirty tree; bootstrap/detect writes before a branch exists while never committing to main. Every new spec blocks itself. FR-020, FR-040, US2/AC1. T114.
SKILL sections 1 and 9: any preflight failure sets stageStatus blocked and releases the lock, so a contended driver would write the record and delete the owner's lock. FR-022, S3. T115.

SKILL converge step 2 allows changes only in tasks.md and .iskender/state/, but entering the stage already changed docs/17 and commits happen at stage end. Hit on this pass; worked around by committing on entry (7aefc88), which the skill does not prescribe. FR-030, C1. T116.
SKILL converge step 1 increments passNumber unconditionally, and a resume re-runs converge, so a crash or blocked retry adds a pass and reaches pass-4 Low acceptance early. FR-032, SC-005. T117.
review-roadmap requires a ledger with no Medium-or-above finding regardless of status, while remediated findings keep their severity, so a spec that ever had one can never pass. FR-033, FR-036. T118.
pr-merge-checkpoint has no step for an open records PR, so it recreates the chore branch, or reads complete on that branch and starts the next spec before a human merges. FR-024b, FR-022. T119.

ProjectGraph.cs checks only A1-A4, so edges outside the approved direction such as Domain to Management pass; DependencyDirectionTests.cs:37 loads only src, so a test project referencing Host passes despite A2's 'no project'. FR-006, US1/AC6. T120.
Re-run 2026-11-06: a zero-byte .specify/memory/constitution.md gives check-grounding OK, and the skill then treats it as authoritative. FR-014, FR-019a, SC-003. T121.

SKILL section 2 reads records from the current checkout, and they live only on the spec branch until merge, so from main or a fresh clone an in-progress spec restarts at bootstrap/detect. FR-020, FR-022, US2/AC3. T122.
SKILL sets SPECIFY_FEATURE_DIRECTORY only for specify; later stages fall back to the git-ignored .specify/feature.json, which may be absent or point at another spec. FR-022. T123.

Classification compares with the previous attempt on the same problem, but the schema stores only a count per problem and one last-attempt object, so the comparison and the blocker's Attempted field have no history after a restart. FR-025, FR-026, FR-035. T124.

FR-025 says 10 failed repairs per invocation run, US4/AC2 says counters persist across invocations, and the skill never says when a run ends, so runFailedRepairs is a lifetime total per spec. SC-006. T125.

Any sourceHashes mismatch blocks with no re-baseline rule, so an approved change to the constitution, manifest, or the spec's prompt during roadmap-review blocks later invocations with no documented exit. FR-022, FR-035. T126.

FR-024b tags the post-merge PR's commit, but spec.md:600, CONTRIBUTING.md:89, data-model.md:79, and both contracts still say feature PR; SKILL step 1 updates the feature PR's notes despite defining 'the PR'. FR-024b, FR-041a. T127.

approvals.json DEC-20261105-001 says approval came before the exact wording was drafted; FR-037 requires a hash over the diff as presented for approval. The hash itself is correct. US5/AC3, Constitution XI. T128.
7d353b7 added an obligation to FR-024b in a committed spec.md after PR 3 merged, outside any Spec Kit stage, with no proposal or decision. Whether it is material is unruled. FR-037. T129.
docs-gate.sh:30 takes all filenames with no status filter. Re-run with a removed doc in the override list passes; the API path was not reproduced. FR-043 requires an added or modified file. T130.
docs/17 is both behavior-bearing and under docs/**, so a PR changing only that file always passes and the gate can never block it; records-only PRs rely on that. FR-043. T131.

review-roadmap handles pending proposals, then reruns the steward on every invocation, and nothing excludes decided proposals, so rejected drift can return under a new ID and re-block the stage. FR-038, FR-039. T132.

review-roadmap writes state without a lock and runs git apply with no branch, commit, or push step, so standalone use on main leaves uncommitted changes to authoritative files. FR-021, FR-040, FR-040a. T133.

review-roadmap says each owner must approve, but its apply conditions check only the hash and a clean apply, and a proposal has one decisionOwner. No effect while one person holds every role. FR-037. T134.
review-roadmap asks the owner to decide any unapplied proposal, yet non-material ones need no approval entry, so an interrupted one asks for a decision it does not need. FR-039. T135.
US5/AC2 requires blocking with the affected IDs; the review-roadmap report and the skill's block name only proposal details and the owner. T136.
Re-run 2026-11-06: a nested unknown key under a known section fails as V1 instead of warning under V8. It fails closed. FR-013. T137.
The gate and contract list only .github/workflows/**, so changes to the CI scripts never trigger it, though FR-043 names CI as behavior-bearing. T138.
